claims.claim_text: ClickHouse 開源 Silk——一個 C++ 的 M:N fiber scheduler，鋪在 OS thread 之下，用 cooperative 排程接住「一萬個微小 I/O 操作」帶來的 tail latency。官方數字：fiber yield 約 3.6ns、io_uring ping-pong 約 7.6µs，首個落地目標是 ClickHouse 的分散式快取層。
claims.evidence: "Silk is a C++ library that gives you a cooperative fiber scheduler"; "a stackful-fiber library and scheduler with a NUMA-aware work-stealing loop"; "About 3.6 nanoseconds per fiber yield with cross-CPU work stealing"; "About 7.6 microseconds for an io_uring ping-pong"; "zero heap allocation in the steady state"; targets "ten thousand tiny operations completed in a particular order"; "the first probable target is our distributed cache". Open-sourced at github.com/ClickHouse/silk.

claims.claim_text: 一篇逐行註解最小 PyTorch 訓練迴圈的文章：forward、loss、backward、optimizer.step、zero_grad 各做了什麼，以及 autograd graph 在背後怎麼被建起來又釋放。
claims.evidence: Source returned HTTP 403 Forbidden; could not be re-fetched, so support is unknown. Not verified against checker knowledge per brief.
claims.note: Source idlemachines.co.uk returned HTTP 403 on re-fetch; the lede visibly attributes to the linked article ('一篇...的文章') rather than asserting independent facts, so it is presented as hedged attribution. Flagged for human review.

claims.claim_text: Cloudflare 替 Workflows 加上 saga 式的 compensating action：durable workflow 跑到一半失敗時，能照反序執行每一步預先定義的補償動作，把已生效的外部 side effect 收回去。
claims.evidence: "saga rollbacks for Workflows, allowing you to declare rollback logic within the step itself, in case of failure."; "If any step fails, the rollback handlers will execute in reverse step-start order."; "if one step fails, it may leave earlier work from completed steps in an inconsistent or partial state."; "This pairing of an operation and its compensation logic is called the saga pattern."

claims.claim_text: Microsoft 在 agent framework 部落格點出一個常見反模式：把太多 context 塞進單一 skill 定義，會浪費 token、也讓模型在工具選擇上變鈍。作者的解法是先量再建——先跑沒有 skill 的 baseline，量出 model 真正缺的那一塊，skill 只補那個缺口、不重講它已經會的。
claims.evidence: Token-waste supported: 'Every token your skill returns occupies space in a finite context window'. Prescription supported after correction: the source advises building a skill that addresses only the gaps found by running a no-skill baseline ('Start by running your scenarios without the skill... What's left after you subtract the baseline?... That's your skill's scope. Nothing more.'). Lede corrected from the unsupported 'small/composable, lazy-load' framing to the source's baseline-subtraction prescription.

claims.claim_text: Stripe 把 Airbnb 開源的 Chronon 特徵平台改造成內部的 Shepherd，用來規模化 ML 特徵開發。重點是讓特徵定義標準化、backfill 與線上／離線一致性都收進同一套框架，服務詐欺偵測這類模型管線。
claims.evidence: "In 2022 we began a partnership with Airbnb to adapt and implement its platform, Chronon, as the foundation for Shepherd"; "the offline, streaming, and online components to compute and serve the features"; API lets developers "define their features once and compute both online and offline features"; fraud use: "an updated ML model for detecting SEPA fraud" that "blocks tens of millions of dollars of additional fraud a year." (Fetched via 301 redirect to stripe.dev.)

claims.claim_text: LWN 盤點無 GIL 的 free-threaded Python：3.13 的實驗版單執行緒會慢上 20–40%，到 3.14 已收斂到 0–10%。3.15 預計帶來同時支援 GIL 與 free-threaded 的統一穩定 ABI，讓 extension 不必再分兩種 build。文中預測無 GIL 會在 3.16 到 3.20 之間某個版本成為預設。
claims.evidence: 3.13: "relatively slow, with 20-40% slowdown on single-threaded workloads"; 3.14: "0-10% slowdown for single-threaded workloads"; 3.15: "a single, stable ABI for both GIL and free-threaded versions of the interpreter" so developers "build their code once and it will load and run on Python 3.15 or later"; prediction: free-threaded "will become the default Python in an upcoming release" "sometime after 3.16 (due October 2027) and before 3.20 (October 2031)," noted as speculation.

claims.claim_text: 到 3.14 已收斂到 0–10% 並拿掉實驗標籤。
claims.evidence: The source ties the removal of the experimental tag to PEP 779 ("described what needed to be done to remove the 'experimental' tag"), not to release 3.14 itself. The article's only 3.14 status statement is performance ("much safer" and "much faster", 0-10% slowdown). It does not assert that 3.14 had the experimental label removed. The lede's pairing of 「3.14」 with 「拿掉實驗標籤」 is not supported as stated; PEP 779 is a forward-looking criteria document.
claims.note: The lede clause '並拿掉實驗標籤' tied tag-removal to 3.14, which the source attributes to PEP 779 (forward-looking), not the 3.14 release. The clause was deleted; the remaining '3.14 已收斂到 0–10%' is supported (see c06).

claims.claim_text: gslin 整理了 Linux 的 Restartable Sequences（rseq）：讓 user space 跑一段臨界區，被 preempt 或 migrate 時由 kernel 負責重跑，藉此實作 per-CPU 資料結構而不必上 atomic。glibc、tcmalloc 這些已經在用它來加速熱路徑。
claims.evidence: The post covers rseq detecting ("rather than preventing preemption") so user space can "detect" interruptions and restart; per-CPU data structures without heavy locking; "malloc algorithm can benefit significantly"; TCMalloc cited ("Restartable Sequence Mechanism for TCMalloc"). Core mechanism (user-space critical section, kernel-assisted restart on preempt/migrate, per-CPU without atomics) and tcmalloc adoption are supported.

claims.claim_text: Anthropic 收購由 Jarred Sumner 創立的 JavaScript runtime 與工具鏈 Bun，用來強化 Claude Code 的基礎設施。官方說 Bun 會維持 MIT 開源授權、繼續對所有開發者開放；同一篇也揭露 Claude Code 在約半年內跑到 10 億美元的 run-rate。
claims.evidence: "Anthropic is acquiring Bun—a breakthrough JavaScript runtime—to further accelerate Claude Code."; "Founded by Jarred Sumner in 2021"; "Bun will remain open source and MIT-licensed, and we will continue to invest in making it the runtime, bundler, package manager, and test runner of choice for JavaScript and TypeScript developers."; "just six months after becoming available to the public, it reached $1 billion in run-rate revenue."

claims.claim_text: 作者給了數字——查某顧客最後一筆訂單快了約 68–85%（省掉 join），但插入訂單因要查 per-customer 序號而慢了約 29–35%。
claims.evidence: Source query speedup: E1 -85%, E2 -68% response-time reduction (range ~68–85%, matching the corrected lede). Insert overhead E1 +29%, E2 +35% ('the transaction takes about one-third longer'), matching 29–35%. Lede corrected from the inflated '85–90%'.

claims.claim_text: tw-fade 是一個 Tailwind CSS v4 plugin，用 scroll-driven animation 加 CSS mask 做出捲動容器的邊緣淡出——「一個 class、零 JavaScript」。瀏覽器支援 Chrome 與 Edge 120+、Safari 26+，Firefox 穩定版目前是靜態淡出的部分支援。
claims.evidence: "Plugin for Tailwind CSS v4"; "Elegant, scroll-driven edge masking. One class. Zero JavaScript."; "Fades appear only when there is more content to scroll, then ease away again at either edge."; "Chrome 120+ on desktop and Android"; "Edge 120+ on desktop and Android"; "Safari 26+ on macOS, iOS, and iPadOS"; "Partial support in stable Firefox: the mask renders, but the reveal falls back to a static always-on fade."
